title: DOE-UAP-D004, Los Alamos Conference on Aerial Phenomena, 1949
doc_notes: This is a transcript of a 1949 Los Alamos conference regarding 'green fireballs' and aerial phenomena, containing detailed investigative reports on specific sightings.

encounters.summary: Dr. LaPaz observed a green fireball on the night of December 12, 1948, which he claims was not a conventional meteorite due to its horizontal path, constant angular velocity, and lack of sound.
encounters.entity_behavior: horizontal path, constant angular velocity, no sound
encounters.quote: was most certainly not a conventional meteorite fall

encounters.summary: A large green fireball observed on January 30, 1949, over New Mexico and Texas, which was investigated by Dr. LaPaz and military personnel; no fragments or sound were reported.
encounters.quote: we saw not one substantiated account of noise produced by the meteorite fall
